cold_email.subject: Interest in Educator / DOWNTOWN SUMMERLIN — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear lululemon Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Educator / DOWNTOWN SUMMERLIN opportunity with lululemon at lululemon.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Guest Service Representative (Rotating Shifts FT & PT) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Vision Hospitality Group, Inc. Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Guest Service Representative (Rotating Shifts FT & PT) opportunity with Vision Hospitality Group, Inc. at Vision Hospitality Group, Inc..

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Coordinator, Institute for Legal Reform — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear U.S. Chamber of Commerce Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Coordinator, Institute for Legal Reform opportunity with U.S. Chamber of Commerce at U.S. Chamber of Commerce.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Lab Analyst I - Semi-volatiles — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear SGS Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Lab Analyst I - Semi-volatiles opportunity with SGS at SGS.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Advancement Associate at Ohio State University Hillel — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Queens Hillel Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Advancement Associate at Ohio State University Hillel opportunity with Queens Hillel at Queens Hillel.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Empirical Research Fellow (Various Academic Depts) — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Northwestern University Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Empirical Research Fellow (Various Academic Depts) opportunity with Northwestern University at Northwestern University.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Fellow — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Hospital for Special Surgery Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Fellow opportunity with Hospital for Special Surgery at Hospital for Special Surgery.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in BioMed Engineer I — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Centinela Hospital Medical Center Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the BioMed Engineer I opportunity with Centinela Hospital Medical Center at Centinela Hospital Medical Center.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Customer Service Representative - East Stroudsburg University — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear AlphaGraphics Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Customer Service Representative - East Stroudsburg University opportunity with AlphaGraphics at AlphaGraphics.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Payroll Specialist — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear OUTRIGGER Hospitality Group Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Payroll Specialist opportunity with OUTRIGGER Hospitality Group at OUTRIGGER Hospitality Group.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Research Associate, Analytical QC — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Bio-Techne Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Research Associate, Analytical QC opportunity with Bio-Techne at Bio-Techne.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

cold_email.subject: Interest in Residency Program Coordinator — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Ascension Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Residency Program Coordinator opportunity with Ascension at Ascension.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

jobs.title: Pfizer CentreOne Commercial Development & Marketing Associate
jobs.location: United States - New York - New York City
jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY Pfizer CentreOne (PC1) is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) embedded within Pfizer, generating over $1B in revenue. PC1 leverages Pfizer’s manufacturing, science, and technology capabilities to support biopharmaceutical partners through custom API synthesis, sterile injectable fill ‑ finish, and highly potent oral solid dose manufacturing. The Commercial Development & Marketing Associate supports a variety of activities across Pfizer CentreOne's inside sales and marketing functions. The role assists with the timely follow-up of marketing-qualified leads through established CRM processes, applying defined guidelines to help review, route, and document lead activity. The Associate also supports marketing projects, content development, and campaign activities while continuing to build commercial knowledge and experience. This position provides opportunities to develop an understanding of Pfizer CentreOne's commercial model through hands-on experience, cross-functional exposure, mentorship, and team collaboration. The Associate will build knowledge of how Marketing, Inside Sales, and Business Development work together to support demand generation and pipeline development, while contributing to day-to-day inside sales activities and marketing initiatives. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Inside Sales Lead Follow-Up Monitor & review new marketing-qualified leads daily in Salesforce across the drug product and drug substance queues, and route ABM leads to the responsible BD team member Review lead information and apply sound judgment and established qualification criteria to determine appropriate routing, disposition, and next steps, including identifying non-qualified opportunities and leads appropriate for nurture campaigns. Execute the personalized outreach sequence (soft lead-in, follow-up, and direct meeting ask) within target timelines — first email within 1 business day, full sequence within 10 business days Log every outreach touch and lead disposition in Salesforce to ensure no lead is left unworked Marketing Project Support Support Marketing initiatives through project coordination, content preparation, campaign tracking, and internal alignment Support lead management activities by reviewing assigned lead queues, completing follow-up activities, and conducting outreach in accordance with established processes and guidelines. Assist with maintaining organized lead, campaign, and reporting documentation in Salesforce, Teams, and SharePoint Contribute to additional Marketing projects and initiatives, coordinating assigned activities and deliverables in support of team priorities. Team & Meeting Support Support preparation and logistics for conventions, internal meetings, BD/Marketing team syncs, and selected customer-facing interactions Coordinate meeting materials, capture action items, and support follow-up tracking for the BD and Marketing teams Respond to routine inside sales and marketing operational inquiries and support appropriate follow-up activities in accordance with established processes and guidance. Commercial Capability Development Learn and apply knowledge of PC1's business model, buyer personas, and lead lifecycle to support effective support management and commercial engagement. Gain exposure to lead generation, inside sales, Business Development, and Marketing to effectively support collaboration across PC1's commercial organization. Develop skills in lead management, outreach execution, and marketing projects while taking on progressively broader commercial responsibilities. Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and a growth mindset aligned to long-term development within PC1 or Pfizer Develop sales skills to continue to progress leads from inception to first meetings and BD hand off BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with 0+ years of experience; OR an associate's degree with 4 years of experience; OR a high school diploma (or equivalent) and 6 years of relevant experience PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or another CRM/marketing automation platform Background in B2B sales development, inside sales, demand generation, or digital marketing, ideally supporting ABM programs or lead-scoring models Exposure to pharmaceutical, CDMO, life sciences, or other technical/regulated industries; interest in building a long-term career within Pfizer or a global commercial organization Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and desire for professional growth. 1–3 years of experience in inside sales, sales development, marketing, or customer-facing business support Comfort with outbound outreach (email sequences, calls) and confidence engaging prospects directly; strong organizational and time-management skills to manage a high volume of leads Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet response-time targets in a fast-paced environment Strong written and verbal communication skills, including persuasive, concise email writing Experience with or willingness to quickly learn Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and marketing automation tools; proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) Professional discretion and ability to handle sensitive customer and pipeline information appropriately Willingness and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS 5-10% - Travel is dependent on meetings and necessity Establishes objectives, goals and plans for own activities OTHER JOB DETAILS Last Date to Apply for Job: November 12, 2026. Referral Bonus Eligibility: YES Eligible for Relocation Package: NO Work Location Assignment: Hybrid The annual base salary for this position ranges from $68,600.00 to $114,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Sunshine Act Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. cold_email.subject: Interest in Pfizer CentreOne Commercial Development & Marketing Associate — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Pfizer Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Pfizer CentreOne Commercial Development & Marketing Associate opportunity with Pfizer at Pfizer.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

cold_email.body:
Dear Walmart Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Continuous Skills Development Trainer opportunity with Walmart at Walmart.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs. Requirements: Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience. Experience supporting SaaS solutions Experience in a startup and/or in a professional services organization highly preferred Experience in HCLS (Health Care and Life Sciences) preferred, but not necessary Outstanding communication skills and capabilities to build long-term business relationships; experience working in teams; Understanding of cloud architecture (application, data, and hosting) - while no coding is necessary, you will need to be deeply technical and be open to learning about Illumina’s tools and applications A passion and high level of comfort interacting with customers with excellent presentation skills to groups internally and externally A strong desire to learn and grow in a rapidly-expanding arm of an established company Ability to work closely with end users in a consultative, services and/or support capability Understanding of commercial software development processes (Agile), software lifecycle management and release management; Knowledgeable of enterprise software standards and cloud-based enterprise application industry trends Travel as needed All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities. cold_email.subject: Interest in Field Applications Scientist 2 - Colorado Remote — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Illumina Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Field Applications Scientist 2 - Colorado Remote opportunity with Illumina at Illumina.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin
https://linkedin.com/in/celina-g-lin

This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Our Associates perform a crucial role in driving our novel cell therapy programs by supporting routine manufacturing operations. We are searching for innovative, intellectually curious individuals with a general understanding of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) to support routine manufacturing operations for Cell Therapy. Successful candidates must be goal-oriented and flexible, with the ability to work effectively and efficiently on a team while demonstrating safety, quality, and GMP compliance at all times. BMS Values • Our values move us toward our mission to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. • Candidates must exemplify the BMS values of Passion, Integrity, Inclusion, Accountability, Innovation, and Urgency. Duties and Responsibilities • Learn and execute Cell Therapy Manufacturing operations compliantly • Execute operations as outlined in Source Governing Documents (including but not limited to: Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions, Batch Records, Forms) • Executes transactions and process in all electronic systems and adheres to business continuity processes • Prioritizes safety of self and others • Reports safety events within 24 hours • Immediately escalates any/all issues that may impact compliance or safety of self and/or others. • Complete documentation required by Source Governing Documents contemporaneously • Perform all tasks in a manner consistent with the safety policies, SOPs, quality systems, and GMP requirements including ALCOA+ • Complete training assignments prior to assigned due date to ensure necessary technical skills and knowledge. • Train for proficiency in process systems and some supporting business systems • Execute the daily unit operations schedule, that includes people, product, and material flow across multiple shifts • Work within a control cleanroom environment and execute aseptic processing procedures (as assigned) • Maintain and cell therapy manufacturing is preferred Working Conditions: • Must be able to stand/walk for extended periods of time • Must be able to work in a cleanroom environment and perform aseptic may have strong magnets • Must be able to work in a BSL2 / ML1 work environment handling human blood components • Work in areas with exposure to vapor phase liquid nitrogen • Must be able to work My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Manufacturing Associate I opportunity with Bristol Myers Squibb at Bristol Myers Squibb.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.title: Technical Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
jobs.description: About the Team At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems. This role sits on the Risk Incubation & Systems (RIS) team, which investigates emerging risks, builds data and automation capabilities, and develops workflows that can scale into durable operational homes. About the Role You’ll build and maintain the data pipelines and shared datasets that teams across USRO use for analysis, measurement, and automation. Working with operational teams and engineers, you’ll turn data from different systems into reliable sources that colleagues can use in their work. You’ll take projects from initial requirements through to production use, with responsibility for testing and documentation. As teams’ needs change, you’ll help maintain and extend the systems you build. Location / work model: San Francisco based with three days in the office. Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential. In This Role, You Will - Work with USRO teams to understand their data needs and define requirements for datasets and reporting. - Build, maintain, and monitor production data pipelines and Airflow DAGs, including scheduling, dependencies, backfills, and troubleshooting failures. - Build and maintain reusable data models, reporting cubes, and shared operational reporting metrics, so teams can use consistent definitions across dashboards and analyses. - Set up data quality and freshness checks, document lineage and ownership, and make the work supportable after handoff. - Document data sources and transformations so colleagues can trace results back to the underlying records.Apply access and privacy requirements when designing datasets and reporting. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Have strong SQL skills and practical experience using Python to build and maintain data pipelines. - Have built and debugged scheduled pipelines that other people depend on. - Practical understanding of data modeling, joins, deduplication, tests, and monitoring. - Ability to trace a surprising metric back to its inputs and explain what downstream users can and can’t conclude. - Experience partnering with non-engineers to turn ambiguous needs into dependable data products. Nice to Have - Experience with Airflow or similar workflow orchestration tools. - Experience transferring prototypes or new workflows into reliable, scaled operations. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society. The Opportunity As a Vendor Operations Associate within the Chief Marketing Office (CMO), you will serve as an operational backbone and strategic partner, managing end-to-end procurement, contracting, and vendor enablement. Manage and execute end-to-end vendor and HCP Self-Service contracts, ensuring rigorous compliance and adherence to legal templates. Create, structure, route, and manage Purchase Orders (POs) in MyBuy, maintaining audit-ready documentation and financial accuracy. Advise business owner stakeholders and external agency partners on optimal contracting approaches, realistic delivery timelines, and end-to-end resource plans. Serve as primary operational super-user, managing vendor relations and resolving complex contracting, purchase order (PO), and multi-line invoicing inquiries. Lead end-to-end onboarding and technical system provisioning for agency partners across enterprise tools including Jira, monday.com, Veeva, Workfront, and Google Workspace. Administer partner profile lifecycles and governance within the External Partner Portal (EPP) and Corporate Identity Management (CIDM) systems. Partner cross-functionally with Commercial and Corporate Services (CCS), Finance, and Procurement to re-engineer workflows, eliminate bottlenecks, and optimize Agency of Record (AOR) processes. Provide tactical procurement advisement during annual commercial campaign planning across key business units (CPO, CMO, DMO, DDA). Who you are Hold a BS/BA degree (or equivalent practical industry experience) with 3–5 years of progressive experience in vendor contract management, procurement operations, or project administration. Energized by finding innovative solutions to optimize workflows, uncover efficiencies, and eliminate operational roadblocks, directly giving time and cost savings back to the business. Self-directed problem solver with strong business acumen, empowered to make critical operational decisions independently and steer competing, fast-paced priorities to completion with close attention to detail. Demonstrate proficiency with enterprise ERP/purchasing workflows (e.g., MyBuy, SAP, or Ariba) paired with foundational accounting knowledge to manage multiline invoicing and PO line structures. Skilled cross-functional communicator capable of building strong working relationships with internal leaders, external agencies, and vendors while handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion. Experienced in navigating enterprise collaboration systems and technical partner access setups (e.g., Google Workspace, Jira, monday.com, or document management tools). Preferred Prior vendor operations, procurement, or contracting experience within the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry. Direct hands-on experience using Genentech's MyBuy system as a superuser, proficient in processing self- and full-service contracts, change orders, and familiar with FACT coding structures. Knowledgeable in onboarding new vendors and suppliers in MyBuy, overseeing Fair Market Value (FMV) classification and ongoing profile maintenance. Hands-on familiarity with pharmaceutical commercial tools and platforms (Veeva, Monday.com, Figma, EPP, CIDM). Demonstrated experience guiding and aligning international agency teams across differing global time zones. jobs.title: Growth GTM Engineer, Revenue Operations
jobs.description: In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. Millions of people and teams adopt Perplexity and Computer on their own, and our marketing programs bring in thousands more leads. To turn that demand into pipeline, every lead has to be enriched, scored, and routed to the right next step within minutes. We're hiring a Growth GTM Engineer on the Revenue Operations team to own the lead-to-engagement engine. You'll orchestrate enrichment across marketing and product leads. You'll build the scoring models that combine firmographic and technographic fit with demonstrated intent and product behavior. You'll own the routing that sends each lead back to Marketing for nurture or to BDRs and Sales for engagement. And you'll help build the custom internal apps our reps use to research, prioritize and engage prospects. You'll report to the Head of Marketing Operations, who sets the priorities for this work and owns our marketing automation platform, campaigns and attribution. You'll write production code, own the data and logic between our warehouse and Salesforce, and measure everything you build against meetings, pipeline and revenue. Tech stack: Salesforce | Snowflake | dbt | Python | TypeScript | Clay | Reverse ETL (Hightouch or similar) | Routing and scheduling (Default, Chili Piper or similar) | LLM APIs WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own enrichment orchestration. Design and run waterfall enrichment across third-party data providers, AI research agents and first-party data for every marketing and product lead. Handle lead-to-account matching, deduplication, field governance, data freshness and provider cost, so every record is complete, accurate and ready to act on. - Own and iterate on lead and account scoring. Build fit models from firmographic and technographic attributes such as industry, size, region, tech stack, AI maturity and buying-committee coverage. Combine them with intent and behavior signals: web and content engagement, email and campaign engagement from Marketing Operations, third-party intent, event activity, and product usage signals from the Growth team. Calibrate the models against closed-won and closed-lost data, version them, and explain to Sales why a lead scored the way it did. - Own lead routing. Design the decision logic that sends each lead to Marketing for nurture or to a BDR, AE or Account Manager for engagement, based on score, segment, territory, account ownership, capacity and existing opportunities. Co-define lifecycle stages, handoff SLAs, recycle rules and speed-to-lead triggers with the Head of Marketing Operations, and enforce them in Salesforce and our routing tools. - Close the feedback loop. Instrument the funnel from lead creation to MQL, meeting, opportunity and closed-won. Find where leads stall, which sources and signals predict pipeline, and whether our qualification criteria still hold, then send those insights back into scoring, routing and Marketing programs. Supply the data behind attribution, which the Head of Marketing Operations owns. - Help build custom internal apps for prospect engagement. Ship the tools reps use every day, such as account and prospect research briefs, signal-triggered alerts in Slack and Salesforce, prioritized call and outreach queues, and LLM-powered agents that draft personalized outreach and prepare reps before first touch. Run them like products: talk to users, track adoption and retire what doesn't get used. These apps are part of our BDR prospecting toolset, a combination of internal builds and vendor solutions that the Head of Marketing Operations owns or co-owns. Deliver against that roadmap, including integrating vendor tools with Salesforce and our data layer. - Be the technical owner of the lead data layer. Build and maintain the dbt models, reverse ETL syncs, APIs and webhooks that connect Snowflake, Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment providers and engagement tools. Make sure data flows are observable, tested and trusted. Support the rollout of our first marketing automation platform by building the Salesforce and warehouse side of its sync. - Partner across the business. Work with Marketing, Growth, BDR and Sales leadership, Data Science and Sales Systems to turn messy processes into durable systems. Work with the Growth team, using the PLG signals they publish to drive scoring and routing. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE In your first 30 days: - Audit the current enrichment coverage, scoring logic, routing rules and lead SLAs, and document the gaps that cost us pipeline. In your first 90 days: - Ship an enrichment waterfall with measurable gains in fill rate and accuracy. - Ship an evolution of our unified scoring model that combines fit, intent and product signals, with a published rubric Sales trusts. - Ship routing that sends every lead to nurture or sales within an agreed SLA, with dashboards that show speed to lead and conversion by route. In your first 6 months: - Ship at least one rep-facing engagement app or agent with sustained weekly use by BDRs and AEs. - Show a measurable lift in MQL-to-meeting and meeting-to-opportunity conversion. QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years in GTM engineering, RevOps or Marketing Ops engineering, growth engineering, or data engineering in a B2B SaaS environment, including at least 2 years building enrichment, scoring or routing systems. - Commercial instinct. You start from a revenue problem, like "inbound enterprise leads wait too long for a first touch," and work back to the data, logic or tool that fixes it. - Strong SQL and experience building data models in a warehouse (Snowflake, dbt or similar). You pull your own data. - Production code in Python or TypeScript. You've shipped internal tools, integrations or agents that real users depend on. - Deep working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, ownership), and experience automating within it and integrating with it. - Hands-on experience with enrichment and intent providers and orchestration tools, such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, 6sense, Demandbase or Common Room. - Fluency with funnel mechanics: lead lifecycle design, scoring models, routing and assignment logic, SLAs, attribution data and conversion metrics. - Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, rate limits and error handling across third-party GTM tools. - Operator and business partner mindset. You work directly with reps and marketers, ship fixes quickly, and don't need a PM to translate requests. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in a hybrid PLG and sales-led motion: product-qualified leads, mapping users to accounts, and sales-assist routing. - Experience with routing and scheduling tools (Default, Chili Piper, LeanData) and reverse ETL (Hightouch, Census, Polytomic). - Experience building LLM-powered research, personalization or qualification agents, including evaluation and monitoring. - Experience with statistical or ML-based scoring (logistic regression, gradient boosting) and model calibration. - Entity resolution and domain-matching experience at scale. - Prior GTM Engineer experience at a GTM-tooling or AI-native company.

cold_email.subject: Interest in Automation Engineer — biology/bioinformatics graduate
cold_email.body:
Dear Natera Hiring Team,

My name is Celina Lin, and I recently completed my Honours Bachelor of Science in Biology/Bioinformatics at the University of Waterloo. I am reaching out about the Automation Engineer opportunity with Natera at Natera.

I am especially interested in the team's use of quantitative and computational methods to answer meaningful biological questions. In my independent BRCA1/BRCA2 project, I built a reproducible Python and Snakemake workflow using BCFtools and ANNOVAR to analyze population-specific variants and examine discrepancies between clinical labels and observed allele frequencies. I also completed two bioinformatics internships at the Ontario Institute for Cancer Research, where I developed an LLM-assisted competency-mapping pipeline and created research-data-management learning resources. More broadly, my background in biology, bioinformatics, Python, R, SQL, Linux, and reproducible workflow development aligns well with that kind of cross-disciplinary work.

The combination of rigorous biological questions, collaborative research, and hands-on computational work in this role is exactly the environment in which I hope to grow. I would be grateful for a 15–20 minute conversation to learn more about the lab's current priorities and discuss where my background could be useful. I have attached my resume for context.

Best,
Celina Lin

jobs.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Financial Crimes Investigations team protects Robinhood and its customers by detecting, investigating, and reporting potentially suspicious activity across our brokerage and crypto products. The team partners closely with Compliance, Legal, Product, Risk, and Engineering to strengthen controls and meet regulatory obligations. We focus on thorough investigations, clear documentation, and continuous process improvement to reduce financial crime risk. Our work directly supports regulatory compliance and customer trust. As a Crypto AML Investigator, you will conduct complex investigations involving cryptocurrency transactions, brokerage accounts, and cash movement. You will analyze blockchain activity using industry-standard analytics tools, evaluate customer behavior across Robinhood entities, and prepare Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements. You will manage investigations from initial alert through final decision and documentation, while identifying trends and control enhancements that strengthen our monitoring program. Your analysis will contribute directly to meeting Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) obligations. This role is based in our New York, NY; Denver, CO; or Westlake, TX office(s)office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least [3/4/5] days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct investigations into potentially suspicious activity across cryptocurrency products, brokerage accounts, and fiat transactions generated from transaction monitoring systems, referrals, or external inquiries. Analyze blockchain transactions using tools such as Chainalysis, TRM, or similar platforms to trace fund flows and identify indicators of money laundering or other financial crimes. Review customer activity across Robinhood Financial, Robinhood Securities, Robinhood Crypto, and Robinhood Money to assess risk and determine appropriate case outcomes. Draft clear, well-supported Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory standards and internal quality benchmarks. Manage the full lifecycle of investigations, including alert review, evidence gathering, decisioning, documentation, and case closure. Contribute to process improvements by identifying trends, control gaps, or tooling enhancements that improve investigative quality and efficiency. What you bring 2+ years of AML investigation experience within a broker-dealer, cryptocurrency firm, fintech company, or financial institution, including SAR drafting. Hands-on experience analyzing cryptocurrency transactions and using blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM, or similar tools). Preference for those with course certifications from Chainalysis or TRM Experience working across both fiat and crypto product environments Strong understanding of BSA/AML regulatory requirements, particularly as they relate to virtual currencies and digital asset platforms. Ability to evaluate large data sets, document findings clearly, and make defensible risk-based decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preference for those with ACAMS certification or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation. jobs.title: Product Manager, Ecosystem Relevance
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . About the Team: We help people discover content and communities that make them want to return and participate. Our work connects personalized relevance with the health of the broader ecosystem: helping new users find their interests, elevating quality, and connecting communities with audiences who will value them. We care about both the usefulness of an individual recommendation and how discovery shapes the experience of users, contributors, and communities over time. About the Role: We’re looking for a Product Manager to lead Ecosystem Relevance, with a focus on new user experiences, content and community quality, and community coherence. You’ll shape how our relevance systems serve people when we know little about them, recognize worthwhile content and communities, and account for the context that makes a recommendation appropriate. Working with ML engineering, data science, research, and consumer product teams, you’ll translate these goals into signals, ranking objectives, product experiences, and experiments that improve retention and participation while supporting a healthy ecosystem. What You'll Do: Improve relevance for new users. Own the strategy for cold start recommendations, interest exploration, and early personalization so people find value in their first sessions. Make quality actionable. Develop definitions, signals, and evaluation methods for content and community quality, accounting for usefulness, originality, authenticity, and user feedback. Strengthen community coherence. Improve alignment between what a community is about, the content surfaced from it, and the interests, intent, and expectations of the people discovering it. Shape discovery across the ecosystem. Identify opportunities for new, emerging, and niche content and communities to reach suitable audiences, and address exposure patterns that limit discovery. Translate ecosystem goals into relevance decisions. Partner with engineering on candidate selection, ranking, exploration, diversity, and repetition controls across relevant consumer experiences. Build a balanced measurement framework. Assess early retention, satisfaction, successful discovery, negative feedback, and downstream participation and community health. Lead experiments and execution . Combine behavioral analysis, research, and controlled experiments to identify opportunities, prioritize a roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements with partner teams. What We're Looking For: Experience shipping consumer products in recommendations, discovery, search, personalization, growth, or community ecosystems. Strong product intuition for new users and an understanding of how early experiences influence retention and longer-term participation. Analytical depth: the ability to define metrics, interpret experiments, investigate heterogeneous effects, and distinguish short-term engagement gains from durable improvements. Fluency in recommendation systems and experience partnering with ML engineers and data scientists on signals, objectives, and evaluation. An understanding of ecosystem dynamics, including feedback loops, exposure allocation, content supply, and the relationship between audience growth and community health. The ability to turn concepts such as quality and community coherence into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes. Strong execution and cross-functional influence, with the judgment to navigate tradeoffs among personalization, exploration, quality, and ecosystem health. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Enterprise Build
jobs.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is seeking a Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Build team: the small, high-leverage team that turns the company's best AI-built prototypes into true enterprise-grade services. Robinhood has gone all-in on an AI-accelerated workforce: every week, Hoodies across Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance, and beyond use sanctioned AI tools to build working prototypes of the tools they wish they had. The best of those ideas deserve to become real software. That is this team's entire job, and yours. The team is built on the premise that AI multiplies what a senior engineer can own: agents do the first pass of assessment, porting, and scaffolding; you review, harden, and decide. The work is a distinctive loop. A prototype earns real usage in our experimental sandbox and arrives through a single front door. You assess it, decide what survives, often the idea and the workflow, rarely the code, and rebuild it as an enterprise-grade, production-spec service that meets our full engineering standards: SSO, audit logging, secrets management, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and security review, baked in from the first commit. While you build, you work directly with business partners, the forward-deployed pattern, pointed inward. Robinhood operates in a heavily regulated industry. Building fast here means building safely, and this team exists to help make sure those aren't in tension. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What You'll Do Assess vibe-coded prototypes from across the company and make the technical call: harden, rebuild, or redirect, then own the outcome end-to-end. Design, build, and ship services on Robinhood's enterprise platforms, meeting the company's full standards for secure, reliable enterprise software. Build AI-natively: drive agents through first-pass assessment, porting, and test scaffolding, and ship MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills as production artifacts where the solution calls for them. Work directly with sponsoring business units (Finance, HR, Legal, Compliance) during each build, translating real workflows into software people actually adopt. Deliver clean operational handoffs as part of your definition of done: runbooks, evals, and dashboards. Establish the paved patterns with the Enterprise Platforms team: when you solve the same problem twice, make it a platform capability the third time. Raise the bar on AI-era engineering quality, including rigorous, teaching-quality review of AI-generated code, your own and others'. What We're Looking For 3+ years of software engineering experience building and running production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of independently delivering high-ambiguity projects end-to-end. Hands-on cloud depth, GCP preferred, including containerized services, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with a strong focus on a serverless stack. Demonstrated AI-native development: daily fluency with agentic coding tools, experience building LLM-powered applications or agentic workflows, and the judgment to review, harden, and productionize AI-generated code. Product sense and scoping discipline: you can find the 20% of a prototype worth keeping, say no to the rest, and finish, this team's leverage depends on engagements that end. Exceptional communication with non-engineers: you're comfortable embedded with finance, legal, or HR partners, translating in both directions without losing precision. Experience in highly regulated industries, particularly finance or fintech, is strongly preferred. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $166,000 — $195,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $147,000 — $172,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $130,000 — $152,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. jobs.description: Role Description As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption. You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering. Responsibilities Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria. Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements. Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost. Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria. Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams. Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes. Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps. Requirements Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers. AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations. Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling. Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure. Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams. Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences. Preferred Qualifications Expertise in at least one of the following areas: CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies. Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications. Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customer’s broader security architecture. Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs. jobs.title: Manager, Analytical Engineer
jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Our Team: The Global Product Development and Supply (GPS) Analytics & AI Enablement (A&AIE) team within Business Insights and Technology (BI&T) partners with the Bristol Myers Squibb GPS organization to support data models for all functions within GPS. The team focuses on creating and maintaining the core GPS data layer to enable data models to support answering key business questions that will drive prioritized business decisions using advanced analytics and data science. The GPS organization at Bristol Myers Squibb supports drug development from discovery through commercialization and distribution to patients. Their scope includes portfolio strategy, manufacturing and distribution, network strategy, brand analytics, drug substance, drug product, and analytical development for small molecules, biologics, and cell therapy assets. Job Description: The Manager of Analytics Engineering provides hands-on technical expertise to develop, deploy, and maintain both core data models and core data layer infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on building robust, scalable, and well-documented data models and pipelines, while also enabling self-service analytics across the organization. We are seeking a highly skilled Analytical Engineer to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on data architecture, quality, and governance. The ideal candidate will have experience designing and maintaining dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas), including fact and dimension table design, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), and conformed dimensions across multiple subject areas. This role requires strong technical expertise in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization. Additionally, a successful candidate is an excellent communicator who can effectively explain complex technical information to a wide variety of stakeholders. Key Responsibilities and Major Duties Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data-products to enable data-informed decision-making. Develop a centralized data-layer to deliver data-products at scale to the business. Incorporating domain-specific data marts into a centralized, foundational core. Harmonize data across manufacturing sites, software, and platforms for enterprise-level consumption. Designing highly organized and scalable architectural solutions to drive efficiency. Define orchestration strategies across multiple data domains. Work within a governed metadata framework where documentation is a delivery requirement. Work within Data Build Tool (dbt) to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t-repeat-yourself”) code. Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on-time.
